title: Request disposal of held specimens
purpose: File ordinary disposal requests for the specimens held by a withdrawal that asks for destruction.
summary: File ordinary disposal requests for the specimens held by a withdrawal that asks for destruction. Admin and manager only.

tasks.title: Carry them out
steps: Each request is approved by another person and recorded on its specimen.

good_to_know: One request is filed per held specimen.
Nobody approves their own disposal request.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: One disposal request is filed per specimen held by the withdrawal. Each request still needs approval by another person with disposal approval, and is then executed on the specimen; nothing is disposed here. Specimens picked for a request (with a disposal hold) or with a pending or approved disposal request are skipped. The form lists the held specimens.

items.label: Disposal method
items.description: Required, as your repository's procedure names it.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept on each request. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

Available when a withdrawal holds specimens and requested destruction, either originally or through Escalate to destruction. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, review the current values before trying again. The form keeps your entries and refreshes the version for the next submission.
